examples.japanese: {週報|しゅうほう}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する。
{毎週|まいしゅう}{金曜日|きんようび}に{週報|しゅうほう}を{書|か}いている。
examples.english: I write a weekly report every Friday.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}から{週報|しゅうほう}の{内容|ないよう}についてフィードバックをもらった。
examples.english: I received feedback from my boss on the content of my weekly report.

notes:
A regular report submitted on a weekly basis, common in Japanese workplaces. Part of a series of periodic report terms built on the same pattern.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {週報|しゅうほう}を{提出|ていしゅつ}する: to submit a weekly report
- {週報|しゅうほう}を{書|か}く: to write a weekly report
- {業務|ぎょうむ}{週報|しゅうほう}: work weekly report

RELATED TERMS:
- {日報|にっぽう}: daily report
- {月報|げっぽう}: monthly report
- {年報|ねんぽう}: annual report

USAGE:
In Japanese business culture, {週報|しゅうほう} is a standard tool for reporting progress to supervisors. It typically summarizes the week's accomplishments, challenges, and plans for the following week.
